g.text: yliapis/dotfiles - how one source tree reaches Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenCode
Everything on the right is generated. Edit ai-coding/ and home-config/, then regenerate with make.
Drift gates: make mirrors-check, skills-index-check, and commands-index-check re-derive each generated tree and exit non-zero when it no longer matches its source.
Flattening rule: every plugin's items land in one directory per tool per kind, so two plugins claiming one name abort the run instead of shadowing each other.
